definitions.short: to scratch , i.e. (by implication) to engrave , plough ; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent , to let alone ; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
definitions.usage: × altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.
definitions.full: H2790. charash I. [ חָרַשׁ ] verb cut in, engrave, plough, devise (Late Hebrew id., plough , so Eth Phoenician חרש , Aramaic (rare) חֲרַת engrave , cleave, plough , Arabic plough ) — Qal Perfect חָֽרְשׁוּ Psa 129:3 , חֲרַשְׁתֶּם Judg 14:18 ; Hosea 10:13 ; Imperfect יַחֲרשׁ Isa 28:24 ; Prov 20:4 ; יַחֲרוֺשׁ Hosea 10:11 + Amos 6:12 (see below); 2 masculine singular תַּחֲרשׁ Deut 22:10 ; Prov 3:29 ; Infinitive construct חֲרשׁ 1Sam 8:12 ; Participle חֹרֵשׁ Gen 4:22 5 t.; חוֺרֵשׁ Amos 9:13 ; plural חֹרְשִׁים Psa 129:3 , חֹרְשֵׁי Job 4:8 3 t., feminine plural absolute חֹרְשׁוֺת 1:14 ; passive חֲרוּשָׁה Jer 17:1 : — 1 cut in, engrave , of worker in metals ׳ח וּבַרְזֶל נְחשֶׁת Gen 4:22 (J), ׳ח נחשׁת 1Kin 7:14 ; figurative ׳ח לִבָּם עַללֿוּחַ Jer 17:1 engraved on the tablet of their heart . 2 plough , literally, human subject (animal usually with בְּ ), no object expressed 1Kin 19:19 ; Deut 22:10 ; Isa 28:24 , so בבקרים יַחֲרוֺשׁ Amos 6:12 (but read probably יָם בבקר יֵחָרֵשׁ , see We and others); with accusative of congnate meaning with verb ׳ח חֲרִישׁוֺ 1Sam 8:12 plough his ploughing (= do his ploughing ), Prov 20:4 ; figurative of Judah Hosea 10:11 ; with ethical reference ׳ח רֶשַׁע 10:13 (|| קצר ), ׳ח אָוֶן Job 4:8 (|| קצר זרע, ); חֹרְשִׁים חָֽרְשׁוּ עַלגַּֿבִּי Psa 129:3 upon my back have ploughmen ploughed (figurative of oppression by wicked); חֹרֵשׁ = ploughman Isa 28:24 ; Amos 9:13 (|| קוֺצֵר ); ׳ח with oxen subject only Job 1:14 . 3 devise (as one who works in, practises ), usually bad sense, object רָעָה Prov 3:29 , רַע 6:14 ; אָוֶן מַחְשְׁבוֺת 6:18 , חֹרְשֵׁירַע 12:20 ; 14:22 ; but also טוֺב חֹרְשֵׁי 14:22 . Niph`al Imperfect 3feminine singular תֵּחָרֵשׁ שָׂדֶה צִיּוֺן Micah 3:12 Zion, as a field she shall be ploughed = Jer 26:18 . Hiph`il Participle עַלֿ רָעָה מַחֲרִישׁ 1Sam 23:9 fabricating mischief against (see Dr, and compare We). II. [ חָרֵשׁ ] verb 1. be silent, dumb, speechless ; 2 be deaf; chiefly poet . (Late Hebrew Pi`el make deaf ; Aramaic , be dumb, deaf ; Arabic be dumb, speechless , compare Assyrian —arâšu , restrain , according to Dl Pr 100 ; see Lag BN 120 ) — Qal Imperfect יֶחֱרָ֑שׁ Psa 50:3 ; 2 masculine singular תֶּחֱרַשׁ 28:1 ; 83:2 ; תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ 35:22 ; 109:1 ; תֶּחֱרָ֑שׁ 39:13 ; 3 feminine plural תֶּחֱרַ֑שְׁנָה Micah 7:16 ; — 1 be silent , always of God's keeping silence when men pray Psa 35:22 ; 50:3 ; 83:2 ; 109:1 ; followed by אֶלֿ 39:13 . 2 be deaf , subject ׳י , followed by מִמֶּנִּי Psa 28:1 ; subject אָזְנַיִם Micah 7:16 . Hiph`il Perfect חֶחֱרִשׁ Num 30:15 ; Gen 34:5 ; יְחֶחֱרִישׁ consecutive Num 30:5 ; 30:8 ; וְהֶחֱרִשׁ consecutive 30:12 ; הֶחֱרַ֫שְׁתִּי Est 7:4 2 t. etc.; Imperfect יַחֲרִישׁ Num 30:15 2 t. (including Zeph 3:17 see below); 2 masculine singular תַּחֲרִישׁ Hab 1:13 ; jussive תַּחְרֵשׁ 1Sam 7:8 ; 2 masculine plural תַּחֲרִישׁוּן Job 13:5 ; תַּחֲרִשׁוּן Exod 14:14 , etc.; Imperative הַחֲרֵשׁ Judg 18:19 2 t.; הַחֲרִ֫ישִׁי 2Sam 13:20 ; הַחֲרִ֫ישׁוּ Job 13:13 ; Isa 41:1 ; Infinitive absolute הַחֲרֵשׁ Num 30:15 2 t.; Participle מַחֲרִישׁ Gen 24:21 2 t. (including 1Sam 10:27 see below); מַחֲרִישִׁים 2Sam 19:11 ; — 1 be silent (= exhibit silence ) a. almost always of men Gen 24:21 ; 34:5 ; Exod 14:14 (all J), Judg 18:19 ; 2Sam 13:20 ; 19:11 ; 2Kin 18:36 = Isa 36:21 ; Jer 4:19 ; Job 6:24 ; 13:5 (twice in verse); 13:19 ; 33:31 , 33 ; Prov 11:12 ; 17:28 ; Psa 32:3 ; Neh 5:8 ; Est 4:14 (twice in verse); 7:4 ; also כְּמַחֲרִישׁ וַיְהִי 1Sam 10:27 (but read rather כְּמֵחֹדֶשׁ ויהי and it came to pass after about a month , ᵐ5 Dr); באהבתו יחרישׁ Zeph 3:17 ( יְחַדֵּשׁ ᵑ6 ᵐ5 he will renew his love, see especially Buhl ZAW see 1885, 183); ׳ח with לְ person keep silence at one, i.e. fail to make objection at proper time Num 30:5 ; 30:8 ; 30:12 ; 30:15 (3 t. in verse) (all P); ׳הח אלי Isa 41:1 pregnantly = come silently unto me ; followed by מִן person cease to speak with Jer 38:27 ; be silent about, pass by in silence , followed by accusative ׳אח בַּדָּיו Job 41:4 . b. rarely of God, permitting evil in silence Hab 1:13 ; Isa 42:14 ; Psa 50:21 . 2 once causat . make silent , with accusative Job 11:3 . 3 be deaf, shew deafness: מִזְּעֹק מִמֶּנּוּ תַּחֲרֵשׁ אַלֿ 1Sam 7:8 be not deaf (turning) from us, so as not to cry . ** Hithpa`el Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיִּתְחָֽרְשׁוּ Judg 16:2 and they kept quiet .
